name: Industry Research Framework
description: Structures deep industry research covering key players, business models, trends, job market dynamics, and entry points. Produces a comprehensive research brief document for career decision-making. Use when the user wants to research an industry before a career move, understand a new market for job targeting, or conduct due diligence on an industry they are considering entering. Do NOT use for company-specific research before an interview (use company-research-guide), competitive analysis for business strategy (use competitive-analysis), or market research for a product (use market-research skills).
